svg.title: A lean pilot's startup cash stack
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-07-startup-budget-stack; chart type: stacked_comparison; title: A lean pilot's startup cash stack; subtitle: Compare cost composition, not promised earnings; chapter number: 4; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: USD; one scenario with four additive components totaling $5,000. This is not a vendor quote or paired market comparison; living expenses are excluded.; caption: Keep a reserve for failed cases and delays; a cheap subscription does not make the business fully funded.; stages: label: Setup and review; value: $1,500; numeric value: 1500.0; detail: Illustrative formation, contract review and insurance allowance; obtain actual quotes.; label: Research tools; value: $600; numeric value: 600.0; detail: Illustrative three-month subscriptions and basic secure working tools.; label: Pilot case costs; value: $900; numeric value: 900.0; detail: Illustrative records, postage and limited paid research.; label: Business reserve; value: $2,000; numeric value: 2000.0; detail: Uncommitted buffer; owner living costs and taxes require a separate plan.
